structured.name: Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct with sampling-tests (T3K) [wh_llmbox]
structured.sampling-test-filter: not test_mixed_params_batch and not TestSeedingAndVariety and not test_repetition_penalty_mixed_batch and not test_presence_penalty_mixed_batch and not test_frequency_penalty_mixed_batch

argv:
python3 /pair/control/.github/scripts/utils/formatter_frozen_requests.py plain --backend vllm --model meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct --dataset-name random --random-input-len 100 --random-output-len 100 --num-prompts 32 --ignore-eos --percentile-metrics ttft,tpot,itl,e2el --save-result --result-filename output/vllm_result.json --random-input-len 4096 --random-output-len 32 --num-prompts 8 --max-concurrency 4
python3 -c 'import json; x=json.load(open("output/vllm_result.json")); assert x["completed"] == x["num_prompts"]'

BUDGET=2048
EXPECTED='Chunked prefill enabled'
grep -q "$EXPECTED" "$FILE_SERVER_LOG"
RESOLVED=$(grep "$EXPECTED" "$FILE_SERVER_LOG" | tail -1 | grep -o 'max_num_batched_tokens=[0-9]\+' | cut -d= -f2 || true)
test "$RESOLVED" = "$BUDGET"
python3 /pair/control/.github/scripts/utils/formatter_frozen_requests.py assertions /pair/plugin/tests/tt/test_chunked_prefill.py -v --tt-server-url=http://localhost:8000 --tt-model-name=meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct --tt-chunked-prefill-budget="$BUDGET"

python3 /pair/control/.github/scripts/utils/formatter_frozen_requests.py plain --backend vllm --model meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct --dataset-name random --random-input-len 100 --random-output-len 100 --num-prompts 32 --ignore-eos --percentile-metrics ttft,tpot,itl,e2el --save-result --result-filename output/vllm_result.json
python3 -c 'import json; x=json.load(open("output/vllm_result.json")); assert x["completed"] == x["num_prompts"]'

python3 /pair/control/.github/scripts/utils/formatter_frozen_requests.py structured --backend vllm --model meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct --num-prompts 32 --percentile-metrics ttft,tpot,itl,e2el --dataset json-unique --output-len 1024 --save-results --result-filename output/vllm_result_structured.json
python3 -c 'import json; assert float(json.load(open("output/vllm_result_structured.json"))["correct_rate(%)"]) == 100.0'
not test_mixed_params_batch and not TestSeedingAndVariety and not test_repetition_penalty_mixed_batch and not test_presence_penalty_mixed_batch and not test_frequency_penalty_mixed_batch

assertion_payload_proof.scope: Exact c1 source functions and actual send_request kwargs exercised offline with a capturing AsyncClient; no server/device/model. All original assertions retained. Fixed local Random seeds, literal nonce/passphrases, budget2048; temperature0, seedNone. Payload equality does not establish runtime determinism.
